detailed_description: AI Text Humanizer is a browser-side text rewriting helper that applies predefined replacement patterns to pasted text. Choose light, medium, or strong intensity, optionally add filler words between some sentences, then click Humanize to generate a rewritten output. The tool provides input and output textareas, Copy, and Clear controls. It is a lightweight rule-based helper and does not score text, verify authorship, or guarantee that meaning, tone, or AI-detection results are preserved.
usage_steps: Paste text into the input textarea.
Choose light, medium, or strong intensity.
Optionally enable the filler words checkbox.
Click Humanize, review the output, then copy or clear the text.
usage_examples: Try a lighter rewrite on a formal paragraph before editing it manually.
Apply stronger replacement patterns to a draft and compare the result with the original.
Add occasional filler words to test a more conversational draft style.
Copy a rewritten text sample into another editor for final review and cleanup.
